description: This source file defines a Swift module that provides functionality to retrieve IPv4 network interface addresses on Darwin (macOS/iOS) platforms. It defines an enum with an internal struct and a static method that accesses system network interfaces, filters for active IPv4 addresses, and returns a list of these addresses.

methods.name: addresses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active IPv4 addresses associated with network interfaces on Darwin systems by calling system APIs and filtering the results.
